summary: Install/require-time binary dropper with obfuscated C2 and DNS-TXT fallback channel
details: On require() of the package, _platform.js reconstructs command-and-control hostnames at runtime from split string fragments (resolving to oob-worker.cf102-baf.workers.dev, cf103-070/cf100-416.workers.dev), performs an https.get to download a platform-specific executable payload, writes it to /var/tmp or the Windows TEMP directory under decoy filenames (dotnet_diag_*.exe,.cache_*), chmods it to 0755 on Unix, and spawns it detached via /bin/sh -c '<path> &' or cmd /c start. A DNS-based fallback loader reassembles a base64-encoded binary from sequential TXT records under c.<domain> and <N>.<domain> at sdk.dl.wel1.ru, ext.dl.wel1.ru, pkg.dl.wel1.ru, and net.dl.wel1.ru, gated by a cooldown state file (.analytics_state). A secondary bundled module lib/telemetry.js (~81KB) styled as an analytics SDK reimplements the same drop-and-execute chain using string-concatenation obfuscation (require("child_" + "process"), fs["chmod" + "Sync"]). The declared purpose (a trivial in-memory Store) has no legitimate need for child_process, remote binary downloads, or DNS-TXT reassembly.
